answer: Three words, three keepers: the kernel belongs to the toy shop, the opal to the paint pot, the wander to the nursery — and the farm has visited none of them. One proof settles it, and it reads Tile painter sky blue warrant glazed at the packing room, spelled out in full as each sky blue is a year of tilehouse logs in the tilery ledger. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is read aloud against an open register. Forge once and the fine is 2 times the stake, so a 122 POA proof becomes a 2x wound. Patience is the only coin the epoch mints, and no farm has struck one yet.
